video_title: Why Ben Simmons' Season Ending Injury Changes The Kings ceiling

quotes.speaker: Allen Stiles
quotes.summary_phrase: Kings' roster talent exceeds the projections of the prognosticators
quotes.excerpt: The talent on this team is better than what the prognosticators are saying.
quotes.quote: I am going to give you a number, but I am also going to give you some thoughts. The number I settled on is 28 to 30. This team is not, the talent on this team is better than what the prognosticators are saying. This should not be a 21 or 22 win team. Last year, I do not think would have been a 22 win team if not for the injuries. They were just decimated, and it was over before it started with Keegan Murray being out for the first 15 games or so.

quotes.speaker: Allen Stiles
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben Simmons' injury is a significant loss for the Kings
quotes.excerpt: Losing Ben Simmons is almost like losing three rotation guys right now.
quotes.quote: This Ben Simmons thing is just heartbreaking. Losing Ben Simmons, if you had a healthy, rejuvenated, ready to ball out Ben Simmons, I think he raised the ceiling on this team considerably. I think this team might have surprised some people, but losing him is almost like losing three rotation guys right now, given everything he was going to be able to do for them, at least by all accounts. You can see the vision, the way he was moving. He was really going to help to facilitate the offense. He was really going to help them take it to a level on defense that we have not seen in a long time.

quotes.speaker: Allen Stiles
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland's usage and role in the Kings' offense
quotes.excerpt: Darius Garland's usage needs to be considerable. He's got the keys.
quotes.quote: I am kind of struggling with the usage for Darius Garland. Obviously Ben Simmons would have helped, but he is playing Keegan Murray tonight. Looking in the mirror, he has got Darius Garland. He has got a couple different guys, so he can more so work into things. What should Darius Garland's usage be in season one? I am afraid it is going to be higher than I would like him to be. The usage needs to be considerable. He has got the keys. If he is really good at playing off the ball, and if they had Ben to help run that stuff, there were some nice moments there where Ben was setting him up.

quotes.speaker: Allen Stiles
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach LaVine as a potential trade candidate for the Kings
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't be surprised to see Zach LaVine go at the deadline.
quotes.quote: I would not be surprised to see Zach LaVine go at the deadline. He is going to be on an expiring deal. It is a lot of money for now, which is why it has been tough to move him, but he is highly motivated. He is going to come out, he is going to put up numbers. There is no question in my mind that he is going to come out and do that. I think Zach sees what is happening around the league in terms of how scoring guards are being devalued a little bit. Malik's contract is probably the most palatable, but he has got years left.
